<h2>Run Pipeline Units With Status Capture</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Runs one isolated pipeline store per unit, continuing after unit failures
while retaining an explicit status row for every requested unit.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_pipeline_units_with_status(
  scale_ids = NULL,
  sel_script = NULL,
  run_pipeline_function = run_pipeline,
  progress = TRUE,
  ...,
  verbose = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="scale_ids">scale_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of unique spatial unit identifiers.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="sel_script">sel_script</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single pipeline script path passed to 'run_pipeline_function'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_pipeline_function">run_pipeline_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable pipeline runner called with 'sel_script', 'store_suffix', and
arguments supplied through '...'. Defaults to [run_pipeline()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="progress">progress</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical scalar controlling the progress indicator. Defaults to 'TRUE'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="...">...</code></td>
<td>
<p>Additional named arguments passed to 'run_pipeline_function'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical scalar controlling per-unit status messages. Defaults to 'TRUE'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>This helper is intended for post-selection full-unit execution. Upstream
tuning-summary production remains fail-fast so tier selection cannot use
incomplete evidence.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tibble with one row per requested unit and columns 'scale_id',
'pipeline_status' ('&quot;ok&quot;' or '&quot;error&quot;'), and 'error_message'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
run_pipeline_units_with_status(
  scale_ids = c("eu_r01", "eu_r02"),
  sel_script = "R/Pipelines/pipeline_paleo_spatial_resolution.R",
  prebuild_interpolation = TRUE
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
